blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Police arrested three individuals for stealing components of the Diokno Pumping Station in Pasay City, Public Works Secretary Vince Dizon said on Monday. Dizon said the individuals stole cables and electronic components worth P183,000 last week. He added that authorities believe two of them work for the station’s contractor, and the contractor would shoulder the cost of replacing the stolen components. “Police officers immediately responded when we reported the incident,” Dizon told reporters in an interview.
